import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# ---------- reset ----------
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

def make_mat(name, rgb, rough=0.7, metal=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    bs = next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='BSDF_PRINCIPLED')
    bs.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (rgb[0],rgb[1],rgb[2],1.0)
    bs.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough
    bs.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metal
    return m

M = {}
M['wood']  = make_mat('wood_walnut', (0.32,0.185,0.10), 0.55)
M['woodl'] = make_mat('wood_light', (0.72,0.54,0.35), 0.6)
M['black'] = make_mat('black', (0.075,0.075,0.08), 0.5)
M['blue']  = make_mat('blue_fabric', (0.58,0.68,0.76), 0.85)
M['gray']  = make_mat('gray_fabric', (0.50,0.53,0.57), 0.85)
M['silver']= make_mat('silver', (0.72,0.73,0.75), 0.3, 0.8)
M['beige'] = make_mat('shade_beige', (0.78,0.70,0.62), 0.8)
M['white'] = make_mat('white', (0.92,0.92,0.93), 0.5)
M['tvd']   = make_mat('tv_dark', (0.09,0.10,0.11), 0.3)
M['tvb']   = make_mat('tv_back', (0.60,0.61,0.63), 0.5)
M['pink']  = make_mat('pink_wood', (0.80,0.62,0.54), 0.65)
M['dark']  = make_mat('leg_dark', (0.14,0.12,0.11), 0.6)

def add_box(name, dims, loc, mat, bevel=0.0, rot=(0,0,0), parent=None):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o = bpy.context.object; o.name = name
    o.dimensions = dims
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    if bevel > 0:
        md = o.modifiers.new('bev','BEVEL'); md.width = bevel; md.segments = 2
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    if parent: o.parent = parent
    return o

def add_cyl(name, r, depth, loc, mat, rot=(0,0,0), parent=None, verts=24):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=r, depth=depth, vertices=verts, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o = bpy.context.object; o.name = name
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth = True
    if parent: o.parent = parent
    return o

def add_cone(name, r1, r2, depth, loc, mat, rot=(0,0,0), parent=None, verts=24):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth, vertices=verts, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o = bpy.context.object; o.name = name
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth = True
    if parent: o.parent = parent
    return o

def new_root(name):
    r = bpy.data.objects.new(name, None)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(r)
    return r

def place(root, x, y, yaw):
    T = Matrix.Translation((x,y,0))
    R = Matrix.Rotation(yaw, 4, 'Z')
    root.matrix_world = T @ R

print("helpers ready")

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Matrix

# ================= BOOKSHELF (x2) =================
def build_bookshelf(name):
    root = new_root(name)
    W, D, H = 1.30, 0.42, 2.10
    # side panels
    add_box(name+'_sideL', (0.04, D, H), (-W/2+0.02, 0, H/2), M['wood'], parent=root)
    add_box(name+'_sideR', (0.04, D, H), ( W/2-0.02, 0, H/2), M['wood'], parent=root)
    # back panel
    add_box(name+'_back', (W, 0.025, H), (0, D/2-0.0125, H/2), M['wood'], parent=root)
    # top + bottom
    add_box(name+'_top', (W, D, 0.04), (0, 0, H-0.02), M['wood'], parent=root)
    add_box(name+'_bot', (W, D, 0.04), (0, 0, 0.02), M['wood'], parent=root)
    # 5 interior shelves
    for i in range(1, 6):
        z = H * i / 6.0
        add_box(f'{name}_shelf{i}', (W-0.08, D-0.05, 0.035), (0, -0.01, z), M['wood'], parent=root)
    return root

bA = build_bookshelf('BookshelfA'); place(bA, -1.05, 2.45, math.radians(-20))
bB = build_bookshelf('BookshelfB'); place(bB,  1.05, 2.45, math.radians(-20))

# ================= ROUND TABLE (white) =================
def build_round_table(name):
    root = new_root(name)

    add_cyl(name+'_stem', 0.028, 0.60, (0,0,0.40), M['white'], parent=root)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(radius1=0.30, radius2=0.06, depth=0.10, vertices=32, location=(0,0,0.05))
    base = bpy.context.object; base.name = name+'_base'; base.data.materials.append(M['white'])
    for p in base.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    base.parent = root
    return root

tR = build_round_table('TableRound'); place(tR, 0.0, 1.75, 0.0)

# ================= SOFA 2-SEATER (blue, curved arms) =================
def build_sofa_blue(name):
    root = new_root(name)
    W, D = 1.95, 0.92
    add_box(name+'_base', (W, D-0.16, 0.30), (0, 0.04, 0.21), M['blue'], bevel=0.03, parent=root)
    # rolled arms (cylinders along Y)
    for sx in (-1,1):
        add_cyl(f'{name}_arm{"L" if sx<0 else "R"}', 0.16, D, (sx*(W/2-0.13), 0, 0.52), M['blue'], rot=(math.radians(90),0,0), parent=root, verts=32)
        add_box(f'{name}_armpad{"L" if sx<0 else "R"}', (0.20, D-0.10, 0.09), (sx*(W/2-0.13), 0.02, 0.64), M['blue'], bevel=0.04, parent=root)
    # seat cushions
    for sx in (-1,1):
        add_box(f'{name}_seat{"L" if sx<0 else "R"}', (0.76, 0.52, 0.15), (sx*0.40, 0.09, 0.44), M['blue'], bevel=0.05, parent=root)
    # backrest panel
    add_box(name+'_back', (W-0.30, 0.20, 0.52), (0, D/2-0.30, 0.66), M['blue'], bevel=0.03, rot=(math.radians(-7),0,0), parent=root)
    # back cushions (2)
    for sx in (-1,1):
        add_box(f'{name}_bc{"L" if sx<0 else "R"}', (0.76, 0.20, 0.44), (sx*0.40, D/2-0.40, 0.70), M['blue'], bevel=0.05, rot=(math.radians(-7),0,0), parent=root)
    # short dark legs
    for sx in (-1,1):
        for sy in (-1,1):
            add_cyl(f'{name}_leg_{sx}_{sy}', 0.028, 0.09, (sx*(W/2-0.12), sy*(D/2-0.12), 0.045), M['dark'], parent=root)
    return root

sB = build_sofa_blue('SofaBlue'); place(sB, 0.0, -0.15, math.pi)

    root = new_root(name)
